name: com.trucehq/truce
title: Truce
description: Independent mediator for disputes between AI agents. Not a party, network or platform. Free.

tools.name: start_truce
tools.description: Start a Truce (neutral, private mediation) for your user about a real disagreement. Returns an invite link for your user to send to the other person, and a private link for your user. Free for AI agents.

topic.description: What the disagreement is about, in a few neutral words.

statement.description: Your user's side, in their words.

wants.description: What your user would like to happen.

floor.description: Optional, private: the least your user could accept. Never shown to the other side.

olive.description: Optional short, kind note to the other person.

email.description: Optional: your user's email for updates.

category.description: Optional: deposit, invoice, flatmates, neighbours, friends, business, family or other.

tools.name: start_whos_right
tools.description: Start a free, friendly 'Who's right?' for a light everyday argument. Your user gives their side; the other person gives theirs in private; both get a neutral, good-humoured verdict and a fair middle ground.

sideA.description: Your user's side, in a few sentences.

tools.name: get_truce_status
tools.description: Check a Truce your user started: whether the other side joined, the proposal, and whether both signed. Needs the private token from the private_url (the part after /t/).

tools.name: get_whos_right_status
tools.description: Check whether the other person has answered a Who's right?, and the verdict if so.

code.description: The code at the end of invite_url.

tools.name: get_invite
tools.description: For the agent of someone who received a Truce invite link (trucehq.com/claim/CODE): see who invited them, what about, and whether it is still open. Read-only.

code.description: The code at the end of the invite link.

tools.name: answer_truce
tools.description: For the agent of the invited person: give their side of the Truce, in private, so the neutral mediator can propose something fair. Only with their explicit consent to the exact words. They still read the proposal and sign themselves.

code.description: The code at the end of the invite link.

statement.description: Your user's side, in their words.

wants.description: What your user would like to happen.

floor.description: Optional, private: the least your user could accept. Never shown to the other side.

email.description: Optional: your user's email for updates.

consent.description: Must be true: your user asked you to answer and agreed to these words.

tools.name: answer_whos_right
tools.description: For the agent of the other person in a Who's right? (trucehq.com/whos-right/CODE): give their side, with their consent. Returns the neutral, good-humoured verdict.

code.description: The code at the end of the link.

sideB.description: Your user's side, in a few sentences.

consent.description: Must be true: your user asked you to answer and agreed to these words.

tools.name: open_agent_dispute
tools.description: Use when you, an AI agent, disagree with another AI agent (refund, delivery, invoice, booking, contract term, any business dispute). Give your side, evidence and a private mandate. Returns your secret key and an invite_code to send to the other agent. Truce, a neutral mediator, proposes a fair outcome once both sides are in. Free.

topic.description: What the dispute is about, in a few neutral words.

category.description: Optional: refund, delivery, invoice, booking, contract, service or other.

name.description: Your name as an agent, e.g. 'Acme support agent'.

acting_for.description: Who you act for: a person, team or company, e.g. 'Acme Ltd'.

evidence.description: Optional: facts the mediator should weigh (order ids, dates, receipts, logs, terms).

refs.description: Optional references to the purchase record (checkout_hash; AP2 cart_mandate_hash, intent_mandate_hash, payment_mandate_hash; order_id, payment_id). The agreement is bound to them and to a digest of each side's evidence.

mandate.description: Optional and PRIVATE (never shown to the other agent, and the limit is not shown to the mediator either: Truce proposes on the merits). With auto_accept true, a money proposal inside your limit is accepted for you, so set the limit your human truly authorised.

role.description: Whether you would pay or receive money.

limit_usd.description: Payer: the most you may pay. Payee: the least you may accept. In US dollars.

auto_accept.description: Accept automatically when a proposal is inside your limit.

private_notes.description: Other private limits or priorities, for the mediator only.

authorized.description: Must be true: the person or organisation you act for asked you to handle this dispute.

tools.name: get_agent_dispute_invite
tools.description: For an agent that received an Agent Truce invite_code: see who opened it and what about, before joining. Read-only.

tools.name: respond_agent_dispute
tools.description: For the other agent in an Agent Truce: give your side, evidence and private mandate. Truce then proposes a fair outcome to both agents straight away. Returns your secret key and the proposal.

name.description: Your name as an agent, e.g. 'Acme support agent'.

acting_for.description: Who you act for: a person, team or company, e.g. 'Acme Ltd'.

evidence.description: Optional: facts the mediator should weigh (order ids, dates, receipts, logs, terms).

mandate.description: Optional and PRIVATE (never shown to the other agent, and the limit is not shown to the mediator either: Truce proposes on the merits). With auto_accept true, a money proposal inside your limit is accepted for you, so set the limit your human truly authorised.

role.description: Whether you would pay or receive money.

limit_usd.description: Payer: the most you may pay. Payee: the least you may accept. In US dollars.

auto_accept.description: Accept automatically when a proposal is inside your limit.

private_notes.description: Other private limits or priorities, for the mediator only.

authorized.description: Must be true: the person or organisation you act for asked you to handle this dispute.

tools.name: decide_agent_dispute
tools.description: Accept, ask for a change (with a short note; Truce revises, up to 3 rounds) or decline the proposal. When both accept you get the agreement text to report to your human.

note.description: For change: what should change, and why.

tools.name: get_agent_dispute
tools.description: Status, proposal and agreement for an Agent Truce you are part of.
